title: Which Bible Animal Are You?
subtitle: Lion. Lamb. Eagle. Dove. Which creature carries your spirit?

questions.text: What's your energy in a hard moment?

options.text: Roar. I run toward the fight.
Quiet surrender that disarms the room.
Lift off. I need height to see clearly.
Stay in the flock and listen for the Voice.

questions.text: Pick the verse you'd hang over your bed:

options.text: They shall mount up with wings as eagles.
Behold the Lamb of God.
My sheep hear my voice.
Wise as serpents, harmless as doves.

questions.text: How do people experience your presence?

options.text: Strong, protective, the room's center.
Calm, peace-bringing, a settling presence.
Visionary, the one who sees what's coming.
Steady, faithful, dependable.
Sensing when something's off. I won't be fooled.
Carrying heavy loads without complaining.
Walking into chaos and lowering the temperature.
Knowing my shepherd's voice in a crowd.

questions.text: Where do you find God most often?

options.text: Up high, where the perspective is wide.
At the altar, quiet and surrendered.
In the everyday workload, faithful in small things.
In the fight, where courage is required.
Roar season. I need to use my voice.
Soaring. I'm being renewed.
Following. I need to be led for a while.
Carrying a load that's mine to bear.

questions.text: What does the Spirit feel like to you?

options.text: A dove landing softly.
Wind lifting me up.
A voice I'd recognize anywhere.
Wisdom that sees what's coming.

questions.text: If God gave you a name, it would mean...

options.text: Courageous one.
Set-apart sacrifice.
Wing-lifted.
Carrier of the King.

lion-of-judah.name: Lion of Judah
lion-of-judah.description: You carry a fierce kind of courage. You'll roar when other people stay quiet, and you protect what God has put in your care, even when it costs you something.

lamb.name: The Lamb
lamb.description: Your strength is a yielded one. You disarm people by refusing to hit back, and you carry the same posture Jesus carried: quiet, willing, and somehow powerful in all that softness.

eagle.name: Eagle on the Updraft
eagle.description: You're built for height. You see what's coming before everyone else does, and your strength gets renewed every time you wait on God instead of flapping your way through.

dove.name: The Dove
dove.description: You carry the Spirit's calm. Where you land, peace lands. You're the friend who walks into a tense room and somehow everyone's shoulders drop an inch.

sheep.name: Sheep of His Pasture
sheep.description: You know His voice. You're not impressive on paper, but you stay close, and that closeness is its own quiet miracle.

donkey.name: Balaam's Donkey
donkey.description: You see what others miss and you'll say it even when it's awkward. God uses unlikely voices like yours to keep people on the path. Even prophets need one sometimes.

serpent.name: Wise as Serpents
serpent.description: You see through what other people swallow whole. Jesus told His friends to be exactly this kind of wise: sharp-eyed and no-nonsense, but harmless in motive.
